China CDE blocks automated browsers via WAF → external workflow for automatable retrieval (third-party endpoint, public query terms only egress, Bearer token REQUIRED — verified: HTTP 401 without it); ChiCTR still user-pastes public page → local parse (no egress). EU CTIS supports retrieve-by-number only (no search). ISRCTN public API is dead. Aggregates phase / status / sponsor / timeline / competitor landscape into JSON / Markdown (optional PNG). B-tier (ordinary input + public retrieval), quickly-adoptable.

设计原则：极简、无用户系统、无积分激励、无惩罚机制。投稿人匿名，内容靠价值驱动。
